messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take escitalopram exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Take escitalopram at the same time each day, with or without food.
Measure liquid medicine carefully. Use the dosing syringe provided, or use a medicine dose-measuring device (not a kitchen spoon).
It may take up to 4 weeks before your symptoms improve. Keep using the medication as directed and tell your doctor if your symptoms do not improve.
Tell your doctor if you have any changes in sexual function, such as loss of interest in sex, trouble having an orgasm, or (in men) problems with erections or ejaculation. Some sexual problems can be treated.
Your doctor will need to check your progress on a regular basis. A child taking escitalopram should be checked for height and weight gain.
Do not stop using escitalopram suddenly, or you could have unpleasant withdrawal symptoms. Follow your doctor's instructions about tapering your dose.
Store escitalopram at room temperature away from moisture and heat.

The relation 'has monitoring requirement' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug necessitates regular assessment or evaluation of the patient's condition as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
D. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
